description: Metis 插件版 - Source of Truth Routes Contract (aligned with performance-runtime TIER_ROLES)

routes.name: Conversational Fast-Path
routes.description: Direct textual answer for greetings, explanations, questions, and non-mutating requests; no subagent dispatch.
routes.notes: Root session answers directly. No gates, no roles.

routes.name: Mechanical Apply
routes.description: Mechanically apply a fully specified change without design decisions. Root closes G4 with independent evidence in the G4 receipt.
routes.notes: Skip G5/G6/G7 and goal-check. Evidence lives in the G4 receipt. Root closes G4; no spawn.

routes.name: Bounded TDD Feature/Fix
routes.description: Exactly one ownership surface: root implements G4, then fresh G5 review and G6 verification. Many steps or files inside that one surface stay T1.
routes.notes: Spawn only reviewer and verifier/fresh-verifier. No juror, no goal-check. Debug inserts G0/G1/G3.5 closed by root before G4. Step count, file count, difficulty, or wanting more agents never raises this to T2/T3.

routes.name: Serial Multi-Surface Feature
routes.description: At least two ownership surfaces that must run serially (shared mutable state, overlapping paths, or ordered dependencies), then independent review/verify, one juror, and goal-check.
routes.notes: Requires ≥2 lanes. One lane is never T2. G2 closed by root (scope-coordinator is not in the T2 spawn allowlist). Conditional G1 planner for design forks. Debug may spawn depth-prober for G3.5. After G6: one juror, then goal-checker.

routes.name: Multi-Surface Fleet
routes.description: At least two pairwise-disjoint ownership surfaces with no shared mutable state that can run in parallel, then integrated G5/G6, sweep, and root goal-check.
routes.notes: G2 executed by root. Implementer lanes are workspace directories with non-overlapping owned paths; a missing directory is not a lane. Overlap or shared mutable state downgrades to T2; a single surface downgrades to T1. wide changes the batch cap, not the lane count. Then reviewer, verifier, sweeper. goal-check executed by root. No planner, juror, or goal-checker spawn.

routes.name: Defect Repair Overlay
routes.description: Root-cause bug fix overlay: G0 characterize, G1 plan, G3.5 depth-lock before implementation on the selected tier.
routes.notes: Inserted before the selected tier's G4. On T1 and T3 these gates are closed by root. On T2, G3.5 may be closed by depth-prober; G7 + goal-check follow G6.
